text:
Maya: Heads up 1: customer 'Helix' wants an accelerated roadmap for tenant-level SLAs: burst capacity, encrypted-models, and deterministic tail-latency. Need cross-team alignment on what's feasible within 6 weeks. What are hard blockers vs negotiable tradeoffs?

Jorge: Runtime summary: we can support burst prewarm + KV-prefetch. Hard blockers: reserved slot pool + fast model swap path (we need a hot pool). Negotiable: quantization level (8->4 bit) if ML ok. Perf estimate for hot-pool work ~2 weeks.

Priya: Infra constraints: private VPC peering + egress IP allowlisting, and we need GPU reservation lead time (3 business days if we have SKUs). Storage: 1TB NVMe for cached weights; network NAT rules need SOC signoff. Booking countdown starts once product confirms SKU.

Nikhil: Security: encrypted-model runtime (in-memory encryption/HSM) is non-negotiable for Helix. Blocker: we need key attestation flow + threat model doc. Shadow mode allowed, but no production keys until attestation passes. Also need an RBAC mapping for tenant ops.

Zoe: ML: can produce a mixed-precision 4-bit baseline, but accuracy drop depends on prompt distribution. Need eval harness and 2000 prompt QA set from Helix. If accuracy drop >1.5% top-metric, we should not ship quantized variant to them.

Sam: SRE ask: define SLOs for pilot. Proposed: p95 < 180ms, p99 < 500ms, error_rate < 0.3%. Canary ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% across 4 days with automated rollback on any SLO breach. Need oncall coverage for ramp days and a postmortem owner assigned.

Omar: Finance: Helix asked for cost cap per 1k tokens. We need a target to evaluate. Rough calc: adding reserved GPUs + HSM adds ~$14k/mo. We can absorb some cost if Helix signs a 6mo commitment.

Jorge: Proposal for minimal launch scope to meet Helix's asks within 6 weeks:
- Feature: tenant HSM integration (shadow-first)
- Feature: hot-pool prewarm (reserved slots)
- Feature: canary + automated rollback
- Quality gate: eval delta <=1.5% for ML metric
- SLO gate: p95 <= 180ms at 10% canary
Owners: runtime=Jorge, infra=Priya, security=Nikhil, ml=Zoe, sre=Sam, product=Maya, finance=Omar

Maya: Good concise list. Two negotiation points for Helix: they prefer 10% initial canary not 5%, and want a cost floor guarantee. Can we agree to 10% if we get a 6mo commit?

Priya: Technically fine with 10% if we book an extra 2 GPUs for headroom. That increases cost to +$18k/mo. Need sign-off from Omar.

Omar: With 6mo commit we can allocate +2 GPUs and amortize cost; Helix would need to commit $X/mo (will draft a number).

Nikhil: On security gating: we can allow 10% canary in shadow mode for HSM (i.e., model runs but keys not used) to test latency & cache without exposing key material. Production HSM flows require attestation pass. So propose two-phase canary:
Phase A: 10% shadow (no keys) -> test perf and caching
Phase B: 10% live keys (post-attestation) -> run SLO checks -> expand

Zoe: That helps. We'll run quantization A/B tests during Phase A to collect metrics against their prompt set. Need Helix data by Wed this week.

Sam: Oncall plan: ramp days + weekend fallback. I need 2 devs from runtime + 1 infra for first 48 hours of live keys. Can we commit names?

Jorge: I'll volunteer Alex (runtime) + Priya to pick infra person.

Priya: I'll nominate Kim (infra) for the live ramp, and will set up subnet and NAT rules this week.

Maya: Action items and deadlines (proposed):
- Helix to provide 2k prompt eval set: due Wed (Helix)
- Zoe to run quant evals and report delta: due Fri
- Priya to reserve GPUs and provision network: due Thu EOD
- Nikhil to publish attestation checklist & threat model: due Thu
- Omar to propose 6mo cost terms: due Fri
- Sam to publish oncall rota for ramp: due Mon
- Jorge to implement hot-pool flow + perf test: initial results Tue next week
If any item is delayed we push the canary start 1 week.

release-bot: Reminder: "Please attach runbook doc and get at least one SecOps approval before scheduling deployment window."

Maya: Decision needed: product ok to ask Helix for 6mo commitment to enable 10% initial canary? If yes, we'll send SOW + cost estimate.

Omar: I'm OK to price it; product should lead commercial ask.

Jorge: Tech note: if Helix declines 6mo commit, we can still do 5% initial canary with existing capacity and no extra GPUs. Performance risk increases for high tail loads.

Nikhil: Security caveat: if Helix refuses attestation window or limits pen-tests, we must block live-key usage. Shadow-only is then our only path. Please call out in SOW.

Maya: Okay team — I'll draft the SOW asking for 6mo and 2k prompts, and cc the owners. If Helix pushes back, we'll fall back to 5% shadow-first plan. Reconvene in this thread with status updates. :calendar: :memo:
